answer: Stake-bonded encounter graphs help aquatic AI-agent economies resist Sybil attacks. On each voyage, autonomous craft exchange short-range acoustic nonces with passing peers and append co-signed receipts to a hash-linked identity thread that verifiers score by graph conductance to discount cliques. Each fake identity therefore demands locked capital plus physical hulls and energy across distinct routes. Yet honest agents patrolling sparse lotus marshes meet too few peers and earn low trust.
